metadata.boundary: Exclusive disposable non-production runtime surface for T004 managed NixOS build/activation and independent closure readback. Before any build or runtime effect, the sandbox materializes and verifies a content-addressed immutable whole-source snapshot from the exact reviewed T002 terminal Git commit, binding the Git commit/tree plus Control Release Set/lock identity. Nix evaluation and build consume only that sandbox-owned snapshot; after binding, no mutable /home/alex/repos/heim-pc checkout, branch, lock or unpinned remote source may participate. The sandbox remains isolated from the productive Heim-PC system, production storage, EFI, firmware and persistent host activation state.
